title: Munk Financial
shortDescription: AI-native financial intelligence for everyday people
description: An AI-native financial intelligence platform that turns personal financial data into clear, source-linked guidance, making expert-grade advice accessible to everyday people.

title: Echo-Echo (e-e)
shortDescription: A Claude-like CLI for financial agents and low-latency market monitoring
description: A terminal copilot for markets: dual-feed monitoring across exchanges and prediction markets, health checks, and session logging. Phase 1 is observe-only — data flowing, no trading yet.

title: Solomon Platform
shortDescription: Local and web agents with visible, provenance-rich execution
description: A multi-agent platform with local computer-use workers and a web control plane on one Go core. Every delegated task remains visible through its graph, output, and provenance trail.

title: Automaton
shortDescription: An agent library where intelligence is decoupled from authority
description: A provenance-first Python library for agents that reason, verify, and propose, but cannot act until a human decision gate grants scoped authority.
